title: Immutability
description: Learn why immutability matters in Redux and how to achieve it.

data.text: **Immutability** means not modifying data directly. In Redux, you must never mutate state - always return new objects.

data.title: Immutable Updates
Nested
Redux Toolkit
data.text: Redux Toolkit uses Immer, which lets you write 'mutating' logic that's actually immutable. This simplifies updates significantly.
